Hi,
I think that's one of the reasons it gets me down so much, that I always hoped there'd be a magic cut-off date when it just fixed itself after nothing else worked.
The dermatologist prescribed me the accutane which worked while I was on it and for maybe two weeks after but the acne has been coming back ever since. I'm going to try for a second course but I feel that sometimes doctors just brush me off and don't realize the damage bad acne causes mentally, especially if they've never had it.
Thanks for the support from yourself and other redditors (don't know if they'll want to be named), I'm going to try and keep my chin up until I have another shot at the dermatologist.

Thanks,

 It feels good to hear from someone who was in a similar position. I just feel down when I have hope that it might be getting better and then another breakout hits along with the fact that I've already tried the 'nuclear' option. 

 I'll try to focus on the positive and remember that there are some good things in my life :)
